mara: Quick check — I opened a small Go SDK PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/427). Two items I want alignment on before landing:
1) runtime toggle to disable client metrics (for private/regulated customers).
2) user-agent + tracing behavior for streaming reconnects / retries.
Can folks weigh in? ping @lee for review when you have a minute.

jonathan: For disabling metrics I'd add a config field `DisableClientMetrics bool` and an env fallback `REDWOOD_DISABLE_CLIENT_METRICS=1`. On the wire we should include a header so server-side can also short-circuit: `x-redwood-disable-metrics: true`. Simple and language-agnostic.

priya: Agree on header name. Prefer `true`/`false` strings vs numeric because some languages treat ints differently across frameworks. Also add README note for enterprise customers.

samir: For streaming + retries: keep the same W3C `traceparent` root so traces stay correlated, but create a new child span for the reconnect attempt. So SDK behavior: reuse trace id, rotate span id on reconnect. That preserves a single root trace while making the reconnect an explicit span.
Example header set we use: `traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01`

anna: UA suggestion: include SDK name/version, language/runtime, OS/arch. e.g. `RedwoodGo/0.12.1 go/1.21 linux/amd64` — keeps parsing easy for server metrics and per-sdk dashboards.

samir: Quick Go snippet for the reconnect header behavior — basically reuse `traceparent` but set a new `span` header we maintain client-side if we need extra granularity:
```go
req.Header.Set("User-Agent", fmt.Sprintf("RedwoodGo/%s go/%s %s/%s", sdkVersion, runtime.Version(), runtime.GOOS, runtime.GOARCH))
req.Header.Set("x-redwood-disable-metrics", strconv.FormatBool(cfg.DisableClientMetrics))
// reuse traceparent from context
if tp := otel.GetTextMapPropagator().Extract(ctx, propagation.HeaderCarrier(req.Header)); tp != nil {
    req.Header.Set("traceparent", tp.String())
}
```
(we'll adapt to our tracer lib — this is pseudocode).

lee: I'll review PR #427 this afternoon. If you put the env var + header tests in a tiny table-driven unit test it's quicker to validate across CI. Ping me if CI flakes.

mara: Thanks — I'll rename the config to `DisableClientMetrics` (consistent with other flags), add `REDWOOD_DISABLE_CLIENT_METRICS` env, send header `x-redwood-disable-metrics: true` when set, and include a cross-lang note in the README. Also will document UA format and tracing guidance in the SDK docs.

ci-bot: build status — PR #427: linux/amd64 go1.21 · tests: 6 flaky, 132 passed · overall: success ✅

jonathan: One more: update the SDK CHANGELOG with the new flag and a short note about traceparent behavior for streaming reconnects. That helps customers debugging distributed traces.

mara: Will do. Thanks all :pray:
